mapper.select:
select method_code.id as methodId, method_code.code as methodCode, method_config.name as methodName, method_config.image_asset_id as imageAssetId, media_asset.url as imageUrl, method_config.description as description, method_config.active as active, method_config.sort_no as sortOrder
from common_code method_code join code_group method_group on method_code.code_grp_id = method_group.id join pay_method_cfg method_config on method_config.method_id = method_code.id join media_asset media_asset on method_config.image_asset_id = media_asset.id
where method_group.group_code = 'PAYMENT_METHOD' order by method_config.sort_no asc

select p.id AS paymentId, p.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, payment_status.code AS paymentStatus, p.amount AS approvedAmount, p.paid_at AS approvedAt, ( select COUNT(*) from orders waiting_order join common_code waiting_status ON waiting_status.id = waiting_order.status_id where waiting_status.code IN ('RECEIVED', 'PREPARING') ) AS waitingOrderCount from payment p join orders o ON o.id = p.order_id join common_code payment_status ON payment_status.id = p.status_id where p.id = #{paymentId}

select order_status.code AS orderStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice from orders o join common_code order_status on order_status.id = o.status_id join code_group order_status_group on order_status_group.id = order_status.code_grp_id
where o.id = #{orderId} and order_status_group.group_code = 'ORDER_STATUS' FOR UPDATE

select exists ( select 1 FROM payment p JOIN common_code payment_status ON payment_status.id = p.status_id JOIN code_group payment_status_group ON payment_status_group.id = payment_status.code_grp_id WHERE p.order_id = #{orderId} AND payment_status.code = 'APPROVED' AND payment_status_group.group_code = 'PAYMENT_STATUS' )
mapper.insert: insert into payment ( order_id, method_id, status_id, amount, paid_at, idempotency_key ) values( #{orderId}, #{methodId}, ( select payment_status.id from common_code payment_status join code_group payment_status_group on payment_status.code_grp_id = payment_status_group.id where payment_status_group.group_code = 'PAYMENT_STATUS' and payment_status.code = 'APPROVED' ), #{amount}, now(), #{idempotencyKey} )
